clues.text: Ezekiel described a towering tree so beautiful that all the trees of this place, in the garden of God, envied it.
A river flowed out of this place to water the garden, then split into four headwaters.
After the man was driven out, cherubim and a whirling sword of flame guarded the east side of this garden.
After leaving the LORD's presence, Cain settled in the land of Nod, just east of this place.
Isaiah said the LORD would comfort Zion and make her wilderness like this place.
In a lament for the king of Tyre, Ezekiel said he had been in this garden of God, covered in precious stones.
Joel said the land ahead of a great invading army was like this garden, but behind them lay desert wasteland.
